korvo_wifi_init.message0: initialize Korvo Wi-Fi agent UI %1 Wi-Fi name %2 password %3 serial debug %4
korvo_wifi_init.tooltip: Starts the screen, touch and audio and connects to the cloud platform. An empty Wi-Fi name uses the saved network, otherwise the KorvoCloud-XXXX hotspot opens for setup; on first use enter the activation code shown on the screen in the platform and bind an agent. Original UI runs the full IDF pages (home, apps, camera, voice, sessions, servo, status) and the drawing, touch and camera blocks have no effect. Needs 16MB flash, OPI PSRAM and an app partition of at least 5MB

korvo_wifi_cloud.tooltip: Connect to or disconnect from the Wi-Fi cloud platform; initialize already connects. Connecting is asynchronous, check "platform online"

korvo_wifi_state.tooltip: Hotspot setup: join KorvoCloud-XXXX from a phone to set Wi-Fi; waiting for activation code: enter it in the platform; needs action: read the status hint; voice agent bound: an agent with realtime voice is bound in the platform; voice connecting: the call is being requested; voice connected: the realtime call is up; listening: the microphone is uploading; playing sound: the speaker still has sound queued

korvo_wifi_info.tooltip: On first use the activation code is here; enter it in the platform to bind. Connection phase is one of idle, setup, connecting, pairing, blocked, online, ready; status code is the platform business code; voice status tells how far the call has got

korvo_wifi_show_status.message0: Korvo show network and activation status on screen
korvo_wifi_show_status.tooltip: Shows the network step, hint, activation code and IP; redraws only when they change, so it can sit in loop

korvo_wifi_reset.tooltip: Reset activation: erases the platform key and requests a new activation code at once, keeping Wi-Fi; unbind this device in the platform console first or the new activation is refused. Clear Wi-Fi: erases the saved Wi-Fi, restarts and opens the setup hotspot; only works when the Wi-Fi name in initialize is empty

options: clear Wi-Fi and set up again

korvo_wifi_ui_page.tooltip: Original UI mode only: switches to the page. The voice page connects with the selected session by itself, or opens the session list when there is none

korvo_wifi_session_new.tooltip: Creates a session for the bound agent and selects it; an ongoing call hangs up and reconnects on the new session. This network request blocks

korvo_wifi_session_refresh.tooltip: Reads one page of up to 8 sessions from the platform; a blocking network request, do not call it on every loop pass. Nothing is requested when there is no next or previous page

korvo_wifi_session_has_page.tooltip: Whether the latest read can page further; the platform only says whether more exist, not how many

korvo_wifi_session_count.tooltip: Number of sessions on the page read last

korvo_wifi_session_get.tooltip: Name, ID or creation time of a session on this page, counting from 1; without a name the ID is returned

korvo_wifi_session_select.tooltip: Selects a session on this page for the following calls; the choice is saved and comes back after a restart for the same agent. An ongoing call hangs up and reconnects on the new session

korvo_wifi_session_delete.tooltip: Deletes the selected session on the platform, which cannot be undone; an ongoing call hangs up first and the list returns to the first page

korvo_wifi_session_delete_at.tooltip: Deletes a session on this page on the platform, which cannot be undone; deleting the current session clears the selection, and the list returns to the first page

korvo_wifi_voice_connect.tooltip: Connects realtime voice on the current session: retries every second while the platform is not ready, up to 10 times, and gives up after 30 seconds. Once connected the microphone streams continuously and the agent replies play by themselves

korvo_wifi_listen.tooltip: Pauses or resumes streaming the microphone to the agent during a call; stopping keeps the call, starting listens for the rest of the call

korvo_wifi_voice_end.tooltip: Stops listening and playback and ends the realtime call

korvo_wifi_on_text.tooltip: Runs when the agent sends new text; get it with "agent text". Do not wait long inside

korvo_wifi_agent_text.tooltip: The latest text received (up to 2048 bytes); Chinese can be shown directly with the screen text block

korvo_wifi_screen_clear.tooltip: Fills the whole screen with one color

korvo_wifi_screen_text.message0: Korvo screen x %1 y %2 show %3 color %4
korvo_wifi_screen_text.tooltip: Shows text with the built-in 14px font, Chinese included, wrapping at the right edge; the landscape screen is 280×240, keep 20px from the corners

korvo_wifi_screen_big.message0: Korvo screen x %1 y %2 show large English %3 color %4 scale %5
korvo_wifi_screen_big.tooltip: Letters, digits and symbols only, scaled 1–8 times

korvo_wifi_screen_rect.message0: Korvo draw rectangle x %1 y %2 width %3 height %4 color %5 %6
korvo_wifi_screen_rect.tooltip: Draws a filled or outlined rectangle

korvo_wifi_backlight.tooltip: Turns the screen backlight on or off

korvo_wifi_camera_preview.message0: Korvo show camera picture on screen
korvo_wifi_camera_preview.tooltip: Captures one frame and draws it in the middle of the screen (240×240); call it in loop for a live preview

korvo_wifi_camera_stop.tooltip: Stops capturing; the screen keeps the last frame

korvo_wifi_touch_pressed.tooltip: Touch is read once per loop pass, so checks and coordinates in one pass come from the same sample

korvo_wifi_touch_point.tooltip: Position of the latest touch: X 0–279, Y 0–239

korvo_wifi_touch_gesture.tooltip: At most one gesture per press: moving more than 42 pixels is a swipe, releasing after less than 15 pixels is a tap. A gesture is kept for 1 second and cleared once read

korvo_wifi_volume.tooltip: Speaker volume 0–100; affects agent speech and tones

korvo_wifi_tone.message0: Korvo play tone frequency %1 Hz for %2 ms
korvo_wifi_tone.tooltip: Plays a sine tone locally and waits until it ends; during a voice call it interrupts the agent

korvo_wifi_mic.tooltip: Captures locally to measure the level only; nothing is uploaded and no network is needed

korvo_wifi_mic_level.tooltip: Peak of the latest frame, 0–100; start local capture first

korvo_wifi_servo.tooltip: External eight-channel servo board (I2C 0x10, GPIO19/20, updated four-byte firmware). 180° position takes 0–180 degrees and 360° position 0–360; pick the mode that matches the servo. All drives the eight channels with one mode. The board state is read back after each command

korvo_wifi_servo_speed.tooltip: Speed of a continuous-rotation servo, -100 to 100; the sign is the direction and 0 stops

korvo_wifi_servo_stop.tooltip: Stop turning: sets a continuous servo to speed 0 (neutral pulses); release: turns the pulses off so the servo no longer holds

korvo_wifi_servo_read.tooltip: Reads back the mode and setting of all eight channels, waiting up to 0.3 seconds; these are controller settings, not measured angles

korvo_wifi_servo_value.tooltip: From the latest read. Setting: angle or speed; mode: 0 released, 1 180° position, 2 360° position, 3 continuous, -1 before a read

korvo_wifi_servo_ok.tooltip: Whether the I2C write of the latest servo command, and the status read after it, succeeded; a successful write does not mean the servo has arrived

korvo_wifi_on_control.message0: when the platform controls ID %1 name %2 type %3
korvo_wifi_on_control.tooltip: Registers a controllable endpoint in the platform and agent and runs when a command arrives; get the value with "platform sent". Use unique IDs of letters, digits and underscores, at most 12

korvo_wifi_control_value.tooltip: Value of the latest platform command: number, switch (true/false) or text

korvo_wifi_report.message0: Korvo report platform data ID %1 name %2 type %3 value %4
korvo_wifi_report.tooltip: Registers a device data endpoint in the platform and updates its latest value, which the platform and agent get when they read it; ID rules as for platform controls, at most 8. Text is at most 16 bytes and not empty
